headline: Moonroot After Dark
body: Moonroot helps city gardeners keep small spaces cared for after sunset. Practical seedlings, simple guidance, and reliable supplies arrive when the work is quiet. Make a rooftop corner feel tended, luminous, and ready for tomorrow’s first light.

placement.rationale: The open navy sky offers clear contrast while keeping the gardener, greenhouse, birds, and moon unobscured.
